source: 545 Order
target: 545 Ordo

source: Combat nuns?
target: Moniales pugnantes?

source: Amidst Lumian’s surprise, he felt a sudden sense of order return to society.
target: Inter admirationem Luminiani, subito sensus ordinis in societatem redire ei sensit.

source: In any country on the Northern Continent, wild Beyonders were unwelcome.
target: In quacumque regione in Continente Septentrionali, Beyonders feri non erant grati.

source: They faced control and even apprehension.
target: Sub coercitione erant et etiam capti fieri possent.

source: This wasn’t like colonies such as Port Farim, where renowned adventurers could freely roam the streets and boast about their experiences without the concern of official Beyonders knocking on their doors.
target: Hoc non erat instar colonarum, ut Port Farim, ubi praeclari viatores in viis libere vagari poterant et de suis experimentis gloriari sine cura, ne Beyonders officiales ianuas pulsarent.

source: “Boss, is there any danger?”
target: “Magister, num quid periculum sit?”

source: Lugano nervously inquired, his perpetual fear evident as a wild Beyonder.
target: Lugano, anxie quaesivit, cum perpetuus timor eius, instar feri Beyonder, manifeste apparebat.

source: Lumian chuckled, responding confidently, “That depends on their attitude.”
target: Lumian risit, fiduciose respondens: “Id ex ipsorum habitus pendet.”

source: The implication was that the nuns were the ones facing danger.
target: Id significabat quod moniales ipsae periculum subire debebant.

source: Lumian teased, “Aren’t you excited about the combat nuns? Shouldn’t you be thrilled that they’re here?”
target: Lumian iocose dixit: “Nonne excitatus es de monialibus pugnantibus? Nonne gaudere debes quod adsunt?”

source: Imagination isn’t the same as reality…
target: Imaginatio non est idem ac res vera…

source: Seeing his boss showing no intention of “teleporting” away with him, Lugano nervously descended and extended an invitation to the combat nuns.
target: Cum videret magistrum suum nullam intentionem habere “teleportare” simul cum eo, Lugano anxie descendit et monialibus pugnantibus invitationem protulit.

source: The leader was the same one Lumian had encountered before.
target: Princeps erat eadem quam Lumian antea convenerat.

source: Most of her naturally curly, thick black hair was neatly tucked into a black hat with white patterns.
target: Major pars capillorum eius, naturaliter crispatorum et densi nigri, rite in galea nigra cum figuris albis collocata erat.

source: Her bright and lively light-blue eyes, along with her thick eyebrows, bestowed upon her a unique and captivating charm.
target: Oculi eius, lucidi et vivaces caerulei, cum supercilia crassissimis, ei gratiam unicam et captantem tribuebant.

source: The woman in leather armor gazed at Lumian and inquired gently, “Are you the adventurer Louis Berry?”
target: Femina, in lorica coriacea induta, ad Lumianem spectavit et leniter inquisivit: “Esne viator Louis Berry?”

source: Lumian nodded. “Who might you be?”
target: Lumian annuit. “Quis es?”

source: The strikingly beautiful combat nun replied with a smile, “I’m Sister Noelia of the Fertility Order, in charge of a combat team.”
target: Monialis pugnans prorsus formosa, cum risu respondit: “Sum Soror Noelia ex Ordine Fertilitatis, praeposita turmae pugnantis.”

source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
target: “Laudetur Terra, laudetur Mater Omnium Rerum!”

source: Noelia raised her hands to the sky, her feet slightly apart.
target: Noelia manus ad caelum extulit, pedes leviter separatos tenens.

source: Observing that Noelia and the other combat nuns of the Fertility Order were not as judgmental as he expected, not viewing wild Beyonders as inherently evil creatures, Lumian smiled.
target: Animadvertens quod Noelia et ceterae moniales pugnantibus Ordine Fertilitatis non tam censoriae viderentur, nec Beyonders feros ut innatos malos spectarent, Lumian subridet.

source: “Madame, what brings you here?”
target: “Domina, quid te hic attulit?”

source: Noelia smiled and explained, “You’re a great adventurer who hunted Demon Warlock. If we hadn’t known you were in Port Santa, we might not have bothered. However, now that we are aware, we must come and speak with you, reminding you to abide by the corresponding order.”
target: Noelia subridens explicavit: “Tu es praeclarus viator, qui Demon Warlock venatus es. Nisi scivissemus te Port Santa esse, fortasse non molestum fuissemus. At nunc, cum nos certi sumus, ad te venire atque te admonere debemus ut ordini congruo obtemperes.”

source: “What order?”
target: “Quid ordo?”

source: Lumian inquired, anticipating the answer while holding the golden straw hat.
target: Lumian quaesivit, responsum exspectans, dum galeam stramineam auream tenebat.

source: The demeanor of these combat nuns made him wonder if they were official Beyonders.
target: Mores harum monialium pugnantium eum faciebant interrogari, num formales Beyonders essent.

source: They didn’t directly arrest him, nor did they use stern warnings.
target: Non eum directe arrestiterunt, nec gravia monita adhibuerunt.

source: Is this the distinction between the Church of Earth Mother and other Churches?
target: Hecne discrimen est inter Ecclesiam Matris Terrae et alias Ecclesias?

source: Emphasizing motherhood and respecting life?
target: Maternitatis extollendo et vitae reverentia?

source: Noelia’s red lips formed a beautiful smile as she spoke, “In other cities, we would issue a direct warning, bringing you under our control. If you dare to resist, you could be apprehended or even eliminated.
target: Labra rubra Noeliae formaverunt venustum risum, dum loquebatur: “In aliis urbibus monitionem directam donneremus, teque sub potestate nostra adduceremus. Si ausus es resistere, capi posses aut etiam interficeraris.

source: However, this is Port Santa, and many sea merchants here have a genuine need to resist pirates and protect their goods.
target: Attamen, hoc est Port Santa, et multi negotiatores maritimi hic veram necessitatem habent ad piratas resistere et merces suas tueri.

source: We lack the manpower to safeguard them all, so we’ve tacitly agreed to allow them to hire Beyonder bodyguards.
target: Copiam virorum non habemus ad eos omnes tuendos, itaque tacite consensimus ut ipsi custodes corporales Beyonder conducere liceat.

source: Monsieur Louis Berry, you are free to roam Port Santa, but you must adhere to three rules:
target: Domine Louis Berry, libere Port Santa perambulare licet, sed tribus regulis obtemperare debes:

source: Firstly, you cannot venture inland without our permission. To reach other cities, you need our approval.
target: Primum, non potes intus in terras ire sine nostra permissione. Ad alias urbes pervenire, consensum nostrum requirere debes.

source: Secondly, you cannot perform any rituals in Port Santa, consume potions for advancement, or engage in mysticism experiments.
target: Secundo, in Port Santa ritus quascumque exercere, potiones ad progressionem consumere, aut experimenta mystica agere non licet.

source: Thirdly, you must refrain from using your abilities to cause chaos or catastrophe.
target: Tertio, debes abstinere a facultatibus tuis ad chaos aut cladem efferendas.

source: Of course, if you return to Port Santa in the future, you’ll need to register with us first.
target: Certe, si in posterum ad Port Santa redieris, primum te ad nos registrare debebis.

source: It’s a reasonable request, and coming from the ruling Church, it’s not excessive at all… It’s even simpler and easier than obtaining a firearm permit in Port Farim or other places.
target: Hoc petitum rationabile est, et quod ex Ecclesia regnante provenit, omnino non est nimis gravatum… Facilius enim et simplicius est quam licentiam sclopetariam in Port Farim aut aliis locis obtinere.

source: Of course, not applying for identification in Port Farim isn’t a big deal.
target: Certe, non postulare identificationem in Port Farim non est res magna.

source: No one will report it, and there won’t be any issues if you don’t directly encounter the officials…
target: Nemo id denuntiabit, nec quaestiones erunt, si officiales non directe occurras…

source: Lumian nodded gently and replied, “Sure thing.”
target: Lumian leniter annuit et respondit: “Certe!”

source: At this moment, Lumian’s thoughts raced, and he couldn’t help but chuckle.
target: Hoc ipso momento, cogitationes Luminiani currere coeperunt, et non potuit nisi subridere.

source: “But Port Santa isn’t entirely safe. I encountered a monster last night…”
target: “Sed Port Santa non prorsus tuta est. Monstrum heri nocte occursum habevi…”

source: He briefly recounted how the little monster had disguised itself as a devil to intimidate him.
target: Brevi enarravit quomodo parvum monstrum se ut diabolus indutus fuisset ad eum intimandum.

source: While he didn’t conceal that he had accepted Giorgia’s commission, he refrained from specifying the details.
target: Quamquam non celavit se mandatum Giorgiae accepisse, de singularibus non enarrare voluit.

source: Noelia listened attentively and responded without surprise, “We’ll handle it. Try not to get involved in the Fisheries Guild’s matters in the future. Their internal issues will be resolved internally.”
target: Noelia attente auscultavit et sine stupore respondit: “Hoc curabimus. Noli in futurum te in rebus Gildae Piscandi implicare; quaestiones internae ipsorum interne solvantur.”

source: Does this mean that the Earth Mother Church refrains from interfering with the internal strife of the Fisheries Guild, allowing them complete autonomy?
target: Hocne significat Ecclesiam Matris Terrae non immiscere in controversiis internis Gildae Piscandi, eos plena autonomia concedere?

source: Lumian smiled and said, “I’ll do my best to avoid participation, but I’ll reserve the right to defend myself and counterattack.”
target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Optime conabor non interesse, sed ius mihi reservabo ut me defendam et contra oppugnem.”

source: Noelia didn’t offer any further comments. Her smile faded as she led the combat nuns to the door.
target: Noelia nullas ulteriores commentationes adiunxit. Risus eius evanuit, dum moniales pugnantibus ad ianuam ducebat.

source: In just two or three steps, she smoothly drew a straight sword from her back, half-turned, and slashed at Lumian.
target: In duobus vel tribus passibus, illa leniter gladium rectum ex tergo extraxit, semivertens, atque in Lumian percussit.

source: The series of movements flowed seamlessly, occurring in the blink of an eye.
target: Series motuum sine intermissione fluebat, in ictu oculi eveniens.

source: Lumian stared at the sword beam, neither dodging nor raising his hand to block.
target: Lumian aspexit gladium, nec evasit nec manum levavit ut obsistiret.

source: With a swoosh, the straight sword grazed the tip of his nose and pointed to the ground.
target: Cum sibilo, gladium rectum apicem nasi eius leviter tetigit et ad terram direxit.

source: Noelia smiled radiantly and nodded in satisfaction.
target: Noelia radianti risu subridens annuit.

source: “As expected of a great adventurer. Your foresight, judgment, and courage are exceptional.”
target: “Ut exspectabatur a magno viatore. Praevisio, iudicium, et fortitudo tua eximiae sunt.”

source: She then turned around and addressed the combat nuns who followed her.
target: Deinde versa est et moniales pugnantibus, quae eam secutae erant, locuta est.

source: “This is a true man. Those who only know how to flaunt their muscles and swing their swords can only be called male beasts.”
target: “Hic est vir verus. Illi, qui solum musculis ostentare atque gladios iactare sciunt, bestiae masculae esse dicuntur.”

source: As they spoke, the combat nuns exited Lumian’s rented suite.
target: Dum loquebantur, moniales pugnantibus conclave locatum Luminiani exierunt.

source: Lumian raised his right hand and stroked his chin, feeling a strange sensation.
target: Lumian dextram manum levavit et mentum palpebrans, sensum mirum sentiens.

source: The sight of women openly scrutinizing men made him uncomfortable.
target: Aspectus feminarum, quae viros aperte perscrutabant, eum incommodum faciebat.

source: After watching Noelia and the nuns leave, Lugano lowered his voice and asked, “Boss, did a little monster really come to warn you last night?”
target: Postquam Noeliam et moniales discessisse vidit, Lugano vocem demittens rogavit: “Magister, num vere parvus monstrum ad te heri nocte venisset ut te moneret?”

source: “That’s right. If you were the one who completed Giorgia’s commission, it might not be just a warning.”
target: “Ita est. Si tu es qui mandatum Giorgiae perfecisti, fortasse non solum monitum esset.”

source: Lumian put on the golden straw hat and casually remarked as he walked towards the door, “We have an obligation to remind our employer that someone is secretly spying on their family.”
target: Lumian galeam stramineam auream induit et, leviter loquens dum ad ianuam perrebat, dixit: “Debemus patronum nostrum admonere, quod aliquis clam in familiam eius speculatur.”

source: Lugano was taken aback for a moment before understanding Lumian’s intentions. He grabbed Ludwig and followed closely behind.
target: Lugano per momentum attonitus est, antequam intentionem Luminiani comprehenderet. Ludwigum arripuit et prope eum secutus est.

source: 21 Saint Lana Street, in the activity room of a suite on the fifth floor.
target: 21 Via Sanctae Lanae, in camera activitatis conclavis in quinto tabulato.

source: Lumian encountered Giorgia once again.
target: Lumian iterum Giorgiam occurrit.

source: Dressed in a vibrant dress adorned with intricate patterns, the lady glanced at the boy, whose appetite exceeded her imagination, before turning her gaze to the adventurer, Louis Berry.
target: Induta vestitu vibranti, intricatis figuris ornato, domina puellum intuebatur, cuius appetitus imaginationem eius superabat, antequam oculos convertit ad viatorem Louis Berry.

source: “What brings you here?”
target: “Quid te hic attulit?”

source: Lugano translated professionally.
target: Lugano perite interpretavit.

source: “Last night, a monster came to intimidate me, but I chased it away.”
target: “Heri nocte, monstrum ad me intimandum venit, sed fugavi eum.”

source: Lumian briefly recounted the monster’s appearance and behavior.
target: Lumian breviter enarravit quomodo monstrum apparuisset ac se comportaverit.

source: Upon hearing Lugano’s account, Giorgia displayed no obvious surprise.
target: Audita narratione Lugani, Giorgia nullam admirationem manifesta ostendit.

source: After a few seconds of contemplation, she said, “Wait a moment.”
target: Post aliquot secundas cogitationis, dixit, “Exspecta paulisper.”

source: Leaving the maid and valet behind, she disappeared into an inner room.
target: Relinquens ancillam atque servum, in conclave interno evanuit.

source: After a few minutes, she reappeared, arm in arm with a man.
target: Post paucis minutis, rursus apparuit, brachio in brachium cum viro.

source: The man seemed to be in his forties, tall and gaunt, his eyes a nearly translucent blue.
target: Virilis vir, quadragenarius, altus et macilento, oculis paene translucidis caeruleis, videbatur.

source: His grayish-black, slightly curly hair cascaded over his shoulders like an artist’s.
target: Capilli eius, nigro-cinerescenti et leviter crispati, super humeros eius labebant, quasi opera artificis.

source: His appearance couldn’t be described as particularly good or bad, yet he possessed an unforgettable quality.
target: Eius aspectus neque prorsus bonus neque malus dici poterat, sed tamen indolem inobliviabilem habebat.

source: “This is my husband, Rubió Paco,” Giorgia introduced.
target: “Hic est maritus meus, Rubió Paco,” inquit Giorgia.

source: The shareholder of the Fisheries Company and a committee member of the Fisheries Guild?
target: Socius societatis Piscandi et membrum consilii Gildae Piscandi?

source: Lumian had gathered information about the Paco family through Lugano over the past two days.
target: Lumian informationes de familia Paco per Lugano in duobus diebus antecedentibus collegit.

source: Rubió’s father had initially been a prosperous fisherman who shared a boat with others.
target: Pater Rubió initio piscator prosperus fuit, navem cum aliis communicans.

source: After marrying Martha, who had once been a Maiden of the Sea, he gradually established himself.
target: Postquam Martha, olim Puella Maris, nupsit, paulatim se statuit.

source: Not only did he manage the Fisheries Company for a time, but he also ascended to become a committee member of the Fisheries Guild.
target: Non solum aliquod tempus Societatem Piscandi administravit, sed etiam membrum consilii veterissimæ Gildae Piscandi factus est.

source: Shortly after the sea prayer ritual last year, the old gentleman passed away.
target: Brevi post ritum orationis maris praeteriti anni, senex ille obiit.

source: With strong support from Matriarch Marta, Rubió inherited his father’s status and became the youngest committee member of the Fisheries Guild.
target: Cum firmo auxilio Matriarcha Marta, Rubió statum patris sui heredavit et membrum consilii Gildae Piscandi iuvenissimum factus est.

source: However, he no longer held a specific position at Port Santa Fisheries Company. He only held onto the shareholders’ voting rights and dividends.
target: Attamen, positionem specificam in Societate Piscandi Port Santa non amplius tenebat. Tantum ius suffragii et dividendorum sociorum retinebat.

source: This middle-aged man had once been rebellious. He was expected to comply with his parents’ arrangements and marry a Maiden of the Sea.
target: Hic vir mediorum annorum olim rebellis erat. Exspectabatur ut parentum ordinationibus obtemperaret atque Puellam Maris in matrimonium duceret.

source: However, he remained single until his early thirties and then married Giorgia, the daughter of a textile merchant.
target: Attamen, solus mansit usque ad annos trigesimos initiales, atque deinde Giorgiam, filiam mercatoris textilis, coniunxit.

source: If it were any other prominent family, the matriarch would have surely intervened and perhaps even banished Rubió. Yet, Martha indulged him and eventually chose to compromise.
target: Si alia familia praeclara fuisset, matriarcha certe intercessisset et fortasse Rubió exsularetur. Tamen, Martha eum indulguit et tandem ad compendium statuit.

source: Before Lugano could commence with the translation, Rubió spoke in less fluent Intisian, “We can communicate directly. When I was young, I often took a boat out to sea and visited places like Port Farim.”
target: Antequam Lugano translationem inciperet, Rubió in lingua Intisiana, minus eleganter, dixit: “Directe communicare possumus. Quando iuvenis eram, saepe navem in mare ducebam et loca sicut Port Farim visitabam.”

source: “Monsieur Rubió, I don’t think there’s a need for communication, and I don’t intend to find out why the monster came looking for me. I’m just here to inform you about this.”
target: “Domine Rubió, non opinor necesse esse colloquium, nec intendo scire cur monstrum ad me quaereretur; hic solum sum ut tibi hoc narrem.”

source: Lumian glanced at the puzzled Giorgia and suspected that Rubió had switched to Intisian not out of politeness but to keep his wife in the dark about something.
target: Lumian ad perplexam Giorgiam aspexit et suspicatus est Rubió in linguam Intisianam conversum esse, non ex urbanitate, sed ut uxorem suam de aliqua re celaret.

source: Rubió nodded gently and said, “I understand your concerns. I merely wish to entrust you with another mission.”
target: Rubió leniter annuit et dixit: “Intelligo sollicitudines tuas; tantum volo tibi aliam missionem tradere.”

source: “What mission?” Lumian asked with a smile.
target: “Quae missio?” subridens quaesivit Lumian.

source: Rubió calmly replied, “My mother, Martha, hails from Milo Village. Recently, she wishes to return and meet the current Governor of the Sea to request his permission to seek treatment at the Church of Earth Mother. Yes, my mother hasn’t been in good health recently. She can’t get out of bed.”
target: Rubió tranquille respondit: “Mater mea, Martha, ex vico Milo provenit. Nuper vult redire atque convenire cum Praefecto Maris, ut licentiam eius petat ad curam quaerendam in Ecclesia Matris Terrae. Ita, mater mea nuper non valde sana fuit; ex lecto surgere non potest.”

source: Martha is still alive? Lumian was slightly surprised.
target: Mater Martha adhuc vivit? Lumian paulo miratus est.

source: Experienced as he was, he deduced that the monster might have been transformed by Martha, based on the absence of the matriarch, the Paco family’s reluctance to expose the humanoid lizard, and the fact that she was once a Maiden of the Sea!
target: Experto se, deduxit monstrum a Martha transformatum esse, propter absentiam matriarchae, familiae Paco reticentiam reptilem humanoidem exponendi, et eo quod illa olim Puella Maris fuisset!

source: The sea prayer ritual wasn’t just an honor for the Maidens of the Sea. Perhaps there was also hidden corruption that might erupt at some point in time.
target: Ritus orationis maris non solum honorem Puellarum Maris attulit; fortasse etiam corruptio abscondita aliquando erumpere potuit.

source: But now, from what Rubió had said, Martha was still alive. Previously, she had only been seriously ill.
target: Sed nunc, ex verbis Rubió, Martha adhuc vivit; antea sola graviter aegrota erat.

source: Where did that humanoid lizard come from? Lumian suppressed his puzzlement and asked in confusion, “Why does Madame Martha need the Governor of the Sea’s permission to seek treatment?”
target: Unde iste reptilis humanoides orta est? Lumian perplexitatem repressit et, confusus, rogavit: “Cur Domina Martha licentiam Praefecti Maris ad curam petendam requirit?”

source: Rubió’s expression shifted, a mix of disgust and resistance evident in his words.
target: Vultus Rubió mutatus est, miscens odium et repugnationem, quae in verbis eius notabilis erat.

source: “All Maidens of the Sea have to follow the orders of the Governor of the Sea when dealing with Church-related matters. Failing to do so would be blasphemous to the sea prayer ritual.”
target: “Omnes Puellae Maris debent imperata Praefecti Maris in rebus Ecclesiasticis parere; id non facere ritui orationis maris blasphemia efficiat.”
